purpose: Quatre propositions de fond pour le hero professionnel Kenz. Image de maquette utilisée comme référence de palette et de composition uniquement.
notes: Images pleines, sans texte ni portrait. La profondeur est composée pour préparer une future parallaxe ; aucun calque séparé ni animation n’est livré à ce stade.

variants.title: 1 · Horizon orbital
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone full-bleed background artwork for the professional homepage of a mobile-app builder, NOT a website mockup.
Reference image 1 is ONLY a reference for the existing website palette, understated editorial mood, and layout. Do not reproduce its person, text, interface, arch or Malaysian scenery.
Create an exceptionally beautiful, premium cinematic landscape artwork, wide 3:2 composition. Color palette is the reference's very dark desaturated midnight navy, blue-black and slate blue, with restrained icy cyan edge lighting. Rich tonal detail in shadows, photographic material realism, refined and believable atmospheric depth. This is a personal universe, quietly ambitious and sophisticated.
Composition follows the reference: the left 48% and particularly the lower left must be dark, low-contrast negative space for a giant ivory serif title and two lines of copy added later. The right third will have a large portrait added later, from x=56% to 92%, y=22% down to the bottom. Keep that portrait zone visually calm and put the most beautiful environmental detail around it, not a tiny focal point hidden behind it. The top 8% is quiet for navigation. The background itself must remain visually rich, not a flat gradient.
Design clear spatial planes, a distant background, midground and near-edge foreground with generous crop margin, so a later implementation can separate them for parallax. A single coherent full frame image, not a layer sheet.
NO people, portrait, words, letters, logos, app icons, UI, frames, panels, watermarks, connected-node diagrams, spacecraft, astronauts, oversaturated purple, neon cyberpunk, or busy bright stars. No montage or contact sheet. Output only the background image.
Primary request: An immense midnight-blue planetary horizon seen from very low orbit, elegantly curved and receding across the frame, conveying real scale and a gentle forward plunge into a personal cosmos.
Scene: The dark softly textured surface sweeps from the lower left foreground toward a distant pale-cyan atmospheric limb around the upper middle / right. Very fine mineral ridges and soft cloud shadows create several layers of depth. A subtle, partially cropped distant moon is tucked near the top right edge, understated. A very sparse deep star field in the upper darkness. The atmospheric rim is narrow, diffused, and graceful, never a brilliant white flare. A faint long band of blue stardust fades behind the horizon. The lower-left copy area stays almost black with only broad quiet relief.
Style: Ultra-premium cinematic space photography, natural optical falloff, monumental silence, elegant scale, restrained blue monochrome. A fully finished standalone background with enough visible detail to feel immersive.

The arcs create beautiful diagonal movement and multi-planar depth without filling the frame with lines.
Style: Premium architectural visualization meets restrained cinematic astronomy, realistic materials and light, elegant editorial backdrop.

The dust is volumetric with beautifully layered translucent veils, dark voids, and fine natural detail, resembling a sophisticated astronomical photograph rather than smoke pasted on black. Sparse tiny distant stars exist at clearly different depths. Three or four barely visible dark asteroid silhouettes are cropped at the extreme right and upper-left edges to provide a quiet foreground plane; no object in the text area. A dim planetary crescent is almost hidden at the far upper-right edge. The lower half transitions into rich blue-black calm with subtle broad haze, suitable for large ivory typography.
Lighting: Blue hour in deep space, low-key and luminous in moderation; no white galactic center, no lens flare, no orange, no purple, no saturated rainbow clouds. Keep the luminous dust primarily in the upper half and outer right so the portrait can remain the visual hero.
Style: Fine-art astrophotography with sculptural 3D depth, expensive film grade, evocative, natural and quiet.
